changedBeliefs: Lowering the ASCII batch-packing guard from 8 params / 8192 total params to 2 params / 64 total params did not improve the Tracelite narrow-batch-insert primary lane
The clean A/B run measured resqlite at +1.45% with neutral verdict and 13.2% max CV, while the sqlite_async guardrail was too noisy to add confidence
Small and narrow batch writes should stay on the generic path unless a future workload shows parameter encoding is a material part of wall time

when experimenting in this direction, prefer the integrated Tracelite A/B wrapper so baseline/candidate histories, policy, decision, insights, and graph data stay together
